summary: Backend-only verification of Round 2 fix to backend/services/higgins/tc_flyby/playbook_runner.py (_registry_like() signal classification + status-derived evidenceSource). Code review confirms the implementation matches the described fix exactly. Ran tests/test_playbook_runner.py (17 new unit tests) and tests/test_calibration_reference_library.py (55-case regression suite) together: 52 passed, 23 skipped, 0 failed — exactly matching the required 35 passed/23 skipped/0 failed outcome for calibration plus all 17 new unit tests green.

minor.issue: Pre-existing, unrelated flaky test: KB retrieval benchmark drifted (top3 0.875 vs recorded 0.893). Not related to playbook_runner.py; needs scripts/kb_benchmark.py --record or investigation separately.
Fails with ProviderFailure('budget_limit') for claude/gpt/gemini adapters — pre-existing environment/LLM-budget issue, unrelated to this fix.

action_items: No action needed on playbook_runner.py — fix verified correct and regression-safe.

(Unrelated, informational) The KB retrieval benchmark and AI-adapter budget-limit test failures are pre-existing environment issues, not caused by this change; flagging for awareness only, not blocking this fix.
critical_code_review_comments: _registry_like() now correctly computes `meaningful = facts with signal not in {weak, missing}`; status is 'verified' only if meaningful facts exist, 'inconclusive' if only weak/missing facts exist, matching PRD requirement exactly.
Evidence string always joins ALL live_evidence fact texts (not just meaningful ones) in both verified and inconclusive branches — nothing is dropped, satisfying BUG FIX 2/3.

run_step() now derives evidenceSource purely from the step's own status via _EVIDENCE_SOURCE_BY_STATUS = {'verified': 'external_verification', 'inferred': 'internal_detection'}, defaulting to 'none' for any other status — satisfies BUG FIX 4, no longer resolver-name-keyed.
run_playbook()'s escalation formula and scoring.py/decide.py were not touched — confirmed via code inspection and by calibration suite passing with the exact same 23 skipped case IDs.

success_rate.backend: 100% for targeted scope (test_playbook_runner.py + test_calibration_reference_library.py); broader full-suite run hit 2 pre-existing unrelated failures (LLM budget limit, KB benchmark drift) not touching playbook_runner.py

seed_data_creation: None — no DB writes, pure unit/logic tests.
